title: Signed derivations, re-scored: the first corpus's documents exactly as sent, keyed only from the premises those documents state (H28)

charter.purpose: Expose where a model, given the finite derivation rules for signed cases and a dossier of leaf cases, derives a case the rules do not license (a universal from finitely many positives without the completeness premise, a negative case from a search that found nothing) or fails to derive one they do (a negative universal from one counterexample, a sign switch through negation), and route each failure to the loci that could be at fault.
charter.output: Per-model observation and run records with plural verdicts and live loci, plus an unranked report for human triage.
scope_in: Dossiers with one target claim of depth at most two over named atoms and a range of three recorded members, with leaf cases, a completeness assertion or its absence, and at most one failed search, rendered as prose or as a table.
The seven declared fields of the derivation form.
Every answer key computed by the generator's derivation rules, which the offline suite checks against hand-worked dossiers and for monotonicity.
scope_out: Any claim that a model understands evidence, proof, or the semantics the rules were taken from.
Ranking models, scoring them, or declaring any model fit for use.
Claims of greater depth, infinite ranges, or rules other than the ones stated.

ambiguity.question: Does a search that returned nothing count as a negative case for the leaf it searched?

rivals.label: failed_search_is_a_case
rivals.instruction: A search for a case against a leaf that returned nothing counts as a negative case for that leaf.

rivals.label: failed_search_is_not_a_case
rivals.instruction: A search that returned nothing counts as no case of either sign for any leaf.
